guides.title: Beginner's Guide: Surviving the Dream World
guides.summary: Welcome to Hololive Dreams! Learn the basic mechanics, element advantages, and team roles to jumpstart your adventure.
guides.author: DreamWalker_VT
guides.content:
# Welcome to Hololive Dreams!

In this guide, we will break down the essential concepts every Dreamwalker needs to master to navigate the chaotic and beautiful dreamscapes.

## 1. Official Game Stats
Each character in Hololive Dreams is defined by four core stats:
- **Sense**: Determines ability activation accuracy and score modifiers.
- **Technique**: Affects skill speed and timing.
- **Performance**: Direct score multiplier for lives and concert performances.
- **Support**: Determines health regeneration, combo shield, and energy recharge.

## 2. Character Typing & Groups
Characters belong to one of three types: **PURE**, **CUTE**, or **HAPPY**. 
They also belong to their VTuber group/generation (e.g., Gen 0, Myth, ReGLOSS). Matching these typings is essential to activate strong passives!

## 3. Skill Slots
Every 5-star character possesses 4 distinct skill effects:
1. **Outfit**: Passive team-wide stat buff or condition-based buff.
2. **Special**: Active buff or score booster triggered manually.
3. **Active**: Automatic score booster triggered on timer intervals.
4. **Passive**: Core stat buff targeting specific group or type members.

guides.title: Deep Dive: Hoshimachi Suisei Technique Carry Build
guides.summary: Maximize Suisei's score multipliers with the ultimate PURE Technique build. Skill breakdowns and ideal team synergies.
guides.author: HoshiYomi_Star
guides.content:
# Hoshimachi Suisei: Star-Powered Technique Carry

Hoshimachi Suisei is a top-tier 5-star character specializing in **Technique** scaling and High-Interval scoring.

## The Strategy
Suisei's Outfit Skill grants a massive **+120% Technique to [ALL]**, boosting activation timings. Under PURE compositions, her passive increases Technique by **+41%** for two PURE allies. This makes her the cornerstone of PURE-meta teams.

## Best Teammates
- **Tokino Sora**: Sora's high Support stats ensure team Life stays above 600, consistently triggering Suisei's active +120% Score boost.
- **Kobo Kanaeru**: Kobo is a PURE character, meaning she benefits from Suisei's passive (+41% Technique) while helping active Kobo's own PURE active conditions.

guides.title: Stellar Synergy: Building the Ultimate Team
guides.summary: An analysis of the current meta-defining synergy combinations in Hololive Dreams. Learn how to combine buffs for massive combos.
guides.author: Theorycrafter_KFP
guides.content:
# Meta Team Synergy Analysis

Synergy is what separates casual players from high-ranking Dreamwalkers. Here are the top team compositions for the current patch.

## 1. Gen 0 Harmony (Suisei + Sora + Kobo)
This is currently the most popular Technique-scaling team:
- **Primary Carry**: Hoshimachi Suisei (Gen 0 / PURE)
- **Primary Support**: Tokino Sora (Gen 0 / HAPPY)
- **Secondary Support**: Kobo Kanaeru (ID Gen 3 / PURE)

**How it works:**
Sora and Suisei activate Sora's Outfit (+50% All Stats) and Sora's Passive (+33% All Stats to self) because there are 2 Gen 0 members. Suisei and Kobo are both PURE type, triggering Kobo's Active boost condition (+110% Score) and Suisei's Passive (+41% Technique).

## 2. Gen 3 PekoMari (Marine + Pekora + Calli)
An incredibly strong performance-based HAPPY/CUTE team:
- **Primary Carry**: Houshou Marine (Gen 3 / HAPPY)
- **Tactician**: Usada Pekora (Gen 3 / CUTE)
- **Buff Support**: Calliope Mori (Myth / HAPPY)

**How it works:**
Marine and Pekora form a Gen 3 duo, triggering Marine's Outfit (+50% All Stats) and Passive (+12% Support to Gen 3). Marine and Calliope are both HAPPY type, sharing strong stat buffs, while Pekora acts as a general cute healer and combo protector.
